title: Component Compatibility Contract
description:
Declares the dependency surface and API/capability surface of a catalog component. Lives as compatibility.yaml next to helm/ + manifests/. Read by the repo's CI gates, NOT packaged into the OCI artifact — task package puts only kustomization.yaml + manifest.yaml in the tarball, so no consumer parses this file.

Schema-contract-parity decisions (rules/schema-contract-parity.md):
1. Closed-vs-open: closed via additionalProperties:false on provides[] items — hygiene and the explicit reject-apis threat-model (a legacy 'apis' key under provides[] fails validation).
2. Duplicate-key behavior: duplicate top-level keys are a YAML authoring error; readers treat the file as corrupt and surface it, not silently last-wins.
3. No schema version field — evolution tracked via git history under harness-evolution review (rules/review-rigor.md 2-round R2 minimum).
4. compatibility.yaml is repo-internal trusted data — no untrusted-data sentinel applies.
5. Per-field mutability: 'requires' and 'provides' are mutable-in-place (version bumps, new capabilities). 'crd-bearing' is mutable-in-place. 'resource_policy' is mutable-in-place (consumer-tunability classification, ADR-0024 Resource-Sizing / docs#159). 'rbac_policy' is mutable-in-place, but NOT silently: its 'baseline' names a committed golden and its 'inert_when_namespaced' mirrors a documented consumer cost, so an edit is a grant change under CODEOWNERS review — task validate:rbac-narrowing turns any drift between the three (render, golden, declaration) red rather than accepting last-write-wins.

Note: structural typing only. sot<->payload consistency (e.g. sot:app requires app: to be set) and render-parity are owned by task lint:version, not this schema.

crd-bearing.description: Marks the CRD-bearing half of a strict-B pair (ADR-0028). When true, the validate:crd-split gate asserts kind:CustomResourceDefinition count > 0 in the rendered artifact.

rbac_policy.description: Declares whether narrowing this component's cluster-wide manager ClusterRoleBinding to namespace scope is a SUPPORTED consumer overlay (ADR-0024 calibrated friction names RBAC consumer-overlayable). Absent = not narrowable: no sanction is documented and task validate:rbac-narrowing skips the component — the safe default, since an undeclared component is simply ungated rather than falsely asserted. Structural typing only; that the named ClusterRole renders, that the golden matches, and that inert_when_namespaced equals the role's cluster-scoped subset are owned by task validate:rbac-narrowing, not this schema.

class.description: 'narrowable' = the component README documents a supported namespace-scoped overlay, and the gate pins the grant a consumer binds. 'fixed' = deliberately NOT narrowable, recorded explicitly (distinct from an absent block, which records nothing).

cluster_role.description: metadata.name of the ClusterRole a narrowing consumer keeps and binds per namespace. The gate extracts this object from rendered/manifest.yaml; the name pattern is a DNS-subdomain subset so the value stays safe to use as a literal in the gate's extraction.

baseline.description: Component-local file holding the golden '<apiGroup>|<resource>|<verb>' triples of cluster_role (conventionally rbac-baseline.triples). Basename only — no path separators, so a declaration cannot point the gate outside its own component directory.

inert_when_namespaced.description: The rules that stop working under the namespace-scoped overlay, because a RoleBinding to a ClusterRole grants nothing on cluster-scoped resources. This is the component README's cost statement in machine-readable form: the gate derives the role's cluster-scoped subset from catalog/rbac-resource-scope.yaml and asserts equality, so an upstream bump adding a cluster-scoped resource fails CI instead of silently invalidating the README.

items.description: One PolicyRule in the same shape rbac.authorization.k8s.io uses, so it can be compared to the rendered role without translation.

apiGroups.description: API groups, with the empty string for the core group (as in a PolicyRule). No minLength on the items for exactly that reason.

allOf.description: Coherence: a 'narrowable' policy MUST name the role, the golden and the cost — the gate cannot check a sanction that declares none of them, and a README-only sanction is the staleness class this block exists to kill.
Coherence: a 'fixed' policy MUST NOT carry narrowing details (they would describe an overlay the component does not sanction).

resource_policy.description: ADR-0024 Resource-Sizing dimension (docs#159). Declares whether a consumer may override this component's container resources. Absent = 'fixed' (safe-by-default; no consumer override). Structural typing only; whether a listed workload/container actually renders is owned by the resource diff-gate (#460), not this schema.

class.description: 'fixed' (default when the block is absent) = the catalog resources are frozen for the consumer. 'tunable' = the consumer may field-scoped strategic-merge patch containers[].resources on the workloads/containers listed in tunable_targets (strict allowlist).

tunable_targets.description: Strict allowlist of consumer-overridable containers. Only listed workload/container pairs are override-able; everything else stays fixed. Required non-empty when class is 'tunable' and forbidden when class is 'fixed'.

workload.description: The workload name whose containers are override-able. Paired with 'kind' as the allowlist key: kind+name together guard against a rename/collision attack (a Deployment and a StatefulSet sharing a name must not both satisfy a name-only rule); the forward-safety diff-gate (#460) matches rendered workloads by kind+name (ADR-0024 Resource-Sizing).

kind.description: The workload kind, required alongside 'workload' so the allowlist keys on kind+name (ADR-0024). Restricted to the container-bearing workload kinds the resource-sizing axis targets; extending this set is a design change gated on the ADR.

containers.description: Explicit container names the consumer may patch. Use '*' as the single entry only when ALL containers of the workload are tunable; mixing '*' with a named container is rejected as ambiguous.

reason.description: Optional rationale documenting why this target is deliberately consumer-tunable.

allOf.description: Coherence: a 'tunable' policy MUST list at least one target (else it advertises tunability but exposes nothing — the silent-no-op class #476 exists to kill).
Coherence: a 'fixed' policy MUST NOT carry override targets.

requires.description: Component and capability dependencies. Keys are either '<sub-layer>/<component>' (version range of another catalog component) or a capability id from catalog/capability-index.yaml. Empty {} is allowed (no dependencies).

provides.description: The API and capability surface this component publishes. Each entry is one named unit (one Helm release, one Crossplane package, etc.).

name.description: The component or package name published by this entry.

version.description: Provenance version block (optional — unbuilt stubs carry no version block; lint:version skips version-less components by design). Structural typing only: sot<->payload consistency is owned by lint:version.

sot.description: The provenance source-of-truth axis. 'app' = running workload version; 'chart' = Helm chart packaging version; 'crd-schema' = CRD schema version; 'none' = built component with no trackable provenance axis.

app.description: Version of the running workload (app-version axis). Present when sot is 'app' or when the chart also carries a distinct app version.

chart.description: Helm chart packaging version. Present when sot is 'chart' or when both app and chart versions are tracked.

crd_schema.description: CRD schema version sourced from the upstream operator. Present when sot is 'crd-schema'.

artifacts.description: Full multi-image cardinality for components that ship more than one image (e.g. hubble, democratic-csi). Each entry is one image with its version.

version.description: Image tag or digest for this artifact.

api_surface.description: CRD API groups or API surfaces exposed by this component. Empty array allowed (most components expose no additional API surface).

capabilities.description: Swappable capabilities this component implements. Optional — omit entirely for components that carry no capability mapping (e.g. lifecycle/providers). Empty [] for deliberate no-capability design state.

swap_class.description: Migration class when swapping implementations. Valid values are owned by catalog/capability-index.yaml (not enum-constrained here to avoid schema drift).

role.description: Role within a multi-component capability (e.g. proxydhcp for bare-metal-boot). Valid values are owned by catalog/capability-index.yaml.
